ai art, shader works or downloaded, and sort by trending, newest or most subscribed. every card says where the item will land before you take it: ai art lands in my scenes under its own vibe, and shader works land in artists under their maker's name. press download . ikandy subscribes to the item on steam and files it for you. the subscribed tab of the workshop panel lists what you have taken, and workshop items enter the finishing chain like every other scene. publish your work launch ikandy through steam: publishing needs the steam client. on the workshop shelf press publish your work , or open the workshop panel from the my scenes header. choose the scene, give it a title and a description, and pick who it publishes as: your steam name or your ikandy handle (a verified shadertoy import can also go out under its original author’s shadertoy name). shader credits and filenames always use the ikandy handle. tick the rights box, press publish to workshop , and accept steam's one-time workshop legal agreement, or the item stays hidden. items are tagged by how they were made and published as public, with a preview image generated for you. renaming a scene later keeps its identity, so the workshop preview does not go missing. preset packs outside the workshop, .ikpack files export a scene as a verified package you can share by hand and import on another pc. the original author’s credit travels with the file, but a verified shadertoy badge stays on the machine that earned it: on another pc the scene shows ordinary credit. tier note browsing the workshop is free. downloading, publishing, and exporting or importing a .ikpack ship in the pro tier; see pricing . the steam page is authoritative. ← previous ai scene generation next → games

title: Games
desc: One Small Step, a shared moon that dances to everyone's music; Slingshot, a gravity-well ship battle; and LUMINAL, a game you play with your own music. All free.
text: user guide / games games one small step, a shared moon that dances to everyone's music; slingshot, a gravity-well ship battle; and luminal, a game you play with your own music. all free. the game tab open the library and pick game. one small step, slingshot and luminal live there, and luminal is in the ring menu too. a gamepad is the way to play one small step, slingshot also works on the keyboard, and in luminal the arrow keys turn the camera. pilot and auto never rotate away from a running game, and pilot never plays a game or a 3d world on its own: start one from the library. one small step a shared moon. everyone on it hears their own music, and the moon turns all of it into one sky. you drive a rover across lunar terrain, jump craters, transform into a plane, and hang out at the drive in, where the screen plays visuals to your soundtrack on a 15 second cycle. other players appear as lights, each in their own permanent color, pulsing at the tempo of whatever they are listening to. one small step opens on its start screen: the title, the choice to join the shared moon or play solo , controls , and exit to the visualizer . joining is free and shares your handle and rover position while you play. you can show up as your ikandy name or your steam name, and switch later in setup, privacy , moon name . you pick your ikandy name yourself: see your name for the rules and how to change it. change your mind any time with the solo or shared chip at the top of the moon, or shared moon presence in setup, privacy . during a drive, press esc , start on the controller, or the menu button on screen for resume , controls and exit . exit takes you back to the visuals you were watching before you started. press c for the controller map. a jumps, y transforms to the plane, b fires a paint comet, m opens the radar map, g opens the gif tray, and a click of the right stick opens and sends a gif. on the d-pad: up for the gif tray, down for a greeting flash, left for the palette, right for a waypoint. your music is your paint. fire a comet during a drop and it paints a fat blazing ribbon; in a quiet bridge, a thin filament. the sky keeps the day's paintings and they fade slowly over hours, so someone arriving late inherits the sky everyone else made. fly like you mean it. jump, then jump again with the stick held: side throws a barrel roll, back a backflip, forward a front flip, with full air control on the sticks. other players see every flip. six mini games: drop chasing, prospecting, groove runs, trick sessions, constellation raising and canvas flats. crystals: park close and hold through the beats. rings: pass them in order on the pulse. the boneyard rewards air tricks. four points of interest: earthrise overlook, prism springs, the boneyard and tranquility ring. the handshake. flash your headlights at someone. if they flash back within a few seconds, an arc of light in both your colors bridges your rovers. sparks and the rover shop. earn sparks through play and spend them on light rigs, trail tints and horn chimes that nearby players can see and hear. every gif plays its sender's horn chime; the gif sounds switch in setup, privacy keeps the moon silent. slingshot a modern gravity-well ship battle. build a fleet from 25 ships on a 200 point budget, five distinct hulls per fleet with a reserve switch, and fight around a planet whose gravity well is the arena. the nebula paints the live spectrum and the well pulses on the beat. solo against easy, medium or hard bots. two players on one keyboard. online, with picks sealed until both players are ready and a ready-up showdown. both players need the same ikandy version; the lobby says so instead of desyncing. during a match, esc , backspace or start opens the match menu: resume , quit to title and exit to the visualizer . a match against the bots or a friend on the same keyboard pauses while it is open, and exit takes you back to the visuals you were watching. xbox pattern controllers throughout. enter or space selects, backspace goes back, and a launch bar ends fleet building. the match is a fixed step simulation with checksums, so a tampered client can only void a match, never win it. slingshot's clean stage puts the pets away. luminal new and early: a game you play with your own music, in its own play mode. find it under game in the library or in the ring menu; the arrow keys turn the camera. clear a realm and its showcase joins your library. tier note joining the moon, driving, flying, painting, the mini games, cosmetics, slingshot in every mode and luminal are free. sending a gif on the moon is a pro feature; receiving them is free. see pricing . ← previous steam workshop next → pets

title: Pets
desc: Five companions who live on the show and dance to the tempo of your music. Free for everyone.
text: user guide / pets pets five companions who live on the show and dance to the tempo of your music. free for everyone. who is out four cats, fruitbat, hobbes, suki and pixel, each with their own personality, and cooper, a blue merle aussie puppy. one cat at a time; cooper can join whoever is out, or run solo. pick a companion middle-click anywhere, or press q , to open the shortcuts wheel of the quick access ring, then pick pets . shift plus right-click opens the same wheel for a mouse without a middle button. choose off, fruitbat, hobbes, suki, pixel or cooper. the choice persists. play with them click a pet to say hello. drag to carry. they always land on their feet. double-click to feed a treat. throw the ball for cooper: throw, bounce, chase, retrieve, return. he will bring it back. always. wiggle the mouse near a cat and watch what happens. each cat has ten dance styles keyed to the live tempo of your music and cooper has four of his own, and every pet has its own show commentary. they walk across the whole screen, including the console bar. on every output pets live on the show itself, so mirrors, recordings, spout, ndi and the wallpaper all see them, at native resolution on 4k output. they stay out when you hide the ui, because hide ui clears the controls, not the show. slingshot's clean stage puts them away. cost having a pet out is cheap: the pet layer is capped at 30 frames per second and uploads only the region it draws. if frames matter more than company, choose off. tier note pets are free for everyone. ← previous games next → controls, themes, tips

title: Controls, themes, tips
desc: Reactivity, seek and volume, three theme layers, UI size, workflow tips.
text: user guide / controls, themes, tips controls, themes, tips reactivity, seek and volume, three theme layers, ui size, workflow tips. controls & themes tune the whole thing the console is the control surface; this page is the small print around it. reactivity, everywhere it matters every visual answers the intensity fader: pull it down and each visual keeps only its own calm motion, push it up and every reaction hits harder, on a scale marked up to 11. on the console, bass, mid and treble add color from each part of the music (pro), and smooth eases the reaction. every knob is one setting for every scene; the reactivity panel holds light-sync, fx pulse, motion warp and motion , which opens the motion window (pro and studio). sensible defaults sit in the middle and work for most music. the seek bar the progress bar in the playback zone is draggable: click and drag anywhere on it to seek, on every source that supports seeking. volume lives right next to it for sources that allow control; anything that does not is greyed with a hint, not hidden. three layers of theme console material : black , a matte powder-coat; chrome , liquid metal with dark text; ultraviolet , blacklight indigo; or tape , studio blue-grey. the whole board, browser, and playlist panel change together. accent color : six swatches, gold, ember, cyan, violet, magenta and lime. the accent runs through every knob, tab, and led. menu opacity : a slider in the same theme menu, in vibe, so the chrome can float over the show as much or as little as you like. add the knobs / sliders switch for how the board's controls render, and a ui size setting (setup, output ) for readability at couch distance. themes change the chrome, never the visuals. set it once, forget it everything persists across sessions: intensity, your look, theme, accent, source preferences, custom preset folders, the last-used look. every console knob is one setting for every scene; a preset saves the console and opens with its scene until you pick another. close it, reopen it, it is your rig. presets set the console the way you like it. every knob you turn is your setting for every scene. to keep a look for one scene, click save , then a slot number (1 to 5). the preset holds every knob, the scene’s own controls, intensity, god rays, lut, the look and motion. on milkdrop and warpfield the scene’s controls are one setting for the whole engine (particles, emitter, coupling and persist are one setting shared by both), so presets do not save them. that preset now opens whenever the scene comes up, and a small dot on its number shows it. click another saved slot to make that one the scene’s preset instead. a scene without a preset plays your own settings. turn a knob while a preset is loaded and your setting changes everywhere; the slot’s number stays underlined until you save it again or pick another. default puts the scene back on your own settings with its controls as shipped, and no preset opens with it until you pick one. with cycle on, each visit loads the scene’s next saved preset. del , then a slot, deletes a preset. to start over, press motion on the console and, under console knobs , press reset console settings : every knob goes back to ikandy’s defaults, and intensity, god rays, lut, the look, motion and your presets stay as they are. right click a knob to reset just that one. to stop presets loading at all, switch presets off with the switch beside the presets label. every scene then opens on your own settings, and your saved presets come back when you switch it on. a preset’s look and motion apply on pro and studio. a preset never raises intensity when it is all the way down. god rays and lut are one switch each for every scene, off until you turn them on. keys setup, keys lists every key, mouse and controller shortcut, and you can click a key to rebind it. a key that opens a feature above your plan shows pro or studio beside it; hover the tag for what it means. esc closes menus and leaves span, and ctrl + shift + d saves a diagnostic file for support. workflow tips layer looks : mix in stage stacks a base, an accent and an overlay into one composite; it is part of studio. scenes and fx shaders run at the same time. for recording or streaming : classic lyric mode over a clean scene with a subtle analog fx reads beautifully on video, and the broadcast overlay switches keep the feed intentional. lyrics need honest metadata : correct artist and title fetch the right words. if lyrics look wrong, check the tags on the playing source first. ← previous pets next → troubleshooting + help

title: Troubleshooting + help
desc: Fixes for the common snags, and where to reach a human.
text: user guide / troubleshooting + help troubleshooting + help fixes for the common snags, and where to reach a human. troubleshooting when things get weird the most common issues people run into, and how to fix them. click any item to expand. now playing says "nothing is playing" windows reports no app is currently registered as the smtc owner. simply start playing music in any app and the message will disappear within a second. if music is playing and now playing still doesn’t see it: firefox : open about:config , set media.hardwaremediakeys.enabled to true , restart firefox. chrome / edge : check chrome://flags for hardware media key handling and set it to enabled . apple music for windows : can be inconsistent. try pausing/resuming, or use a dedicated source instead. now playing controls grey out / next or previous don't work by design. ikandy queries the active app for which transport commands it actually exposes: some apps (single youtube videos, podcasts) don’t advertise next or previous, so ikandy locks those buttons. hover any greyed-out button to see the reason. for broader transport controls, connect a dedicated source such as musicbee, foobar2000, or vlc, or play in an app that publishes full controls to windows media controls. "could not start audio source" / no audio reactivity windows treats system audio capture the same as microphone access for privacy purposes. fix: settings → privacy & security → microphone → toggle let desktop apps access your microphone on. restart ikandy. if that doesn’t help, click 🎤 reconnect audio in setup (⚙) → audio tab . spotify: which controls work? spotify plays through windows media controls. play, pause, and skip work when spotify publishes them; some controls (seek, volume, shuffle) live inside spotify itself. there is no sign-in and no account connection: press play in spotify and ikandy follows. if you followed an older guide that asked for a client id and a spotify developer app, that connection has been removed from ikandy. no setup is needed anymore. vlc won't connect open http://localhost:8080 in a browser: you should see the vlc web ui password prompt. if you don't, the web interface isn't enabled. fix: vlc → tools → preferences → show settings: all → interface → main interfaces → tick web . expand lua below it and confirm a lua http password is set. restart vlc. foobar2000 won't connect in foobar2000 → file → preferences → tools → beefweb remote control , confirm enable http server is ticked. test by visiting http://localhost:8880 in a browser. if you see the beefweb player, the plugin is healthy. if you set a password, paste it exactly as configured in ikandy's foobar2000 settings. musicbee won't connect confirm musicbee is running and that mbxhub appears under edit → preferences → plugins . the mbxhub bundle's mb_mbxhub.dll and mbxhub.exe should be in musicbee's plugins folder. test by visiting http://localhost:8080/docs in a browser. if the mbxhub api documentation loads, match ikandy's host and port to the plugin configuration. the ikandy defaults are 127.0.0.1 and 8080 . if the plugin does not load, confirm .net framework 4.8 and the .net 10 desktop runtime are available (mbxhub 0.5.5.1 and earlier use the .net 8 desktop runtime instead; from 0.5.5.2 on, mbxhub prompts you to install .net 10 when it is missing), then check the mbxhub download page for current requirements and the installation notes . for help with mbxhub itself (installing it, the plugin not loading, its settings), ask in the mbxhub support thread on the musicbee forum . if mbxhub is running and ikandy still won't connect, email support@ikandy.app . install or update problems through steam steam handles installing and updating ikandy. if an install stalls or a launch fails after an update, use steam's built-in repair: right-click ikandy in your library, then properties → installed files → verify integrity of game files . why doesn't ikandy react only to spotify or musicbee when i'm playing a game? by default ikandy captures the entire system audio mix: game sound effects, discord calls, notification pings, and music all go in together. the visualizer reacts to whichever is loudest at any given moment, which is often the game. fix: use per-process capture. open setup (⚙) → audio tab → what to visualize , click scan for apps , then pick spotify or musicbee in the list. ikandy will focus on that app's audio stream while the game keeps running normally. visuals don't react to my music confirm the source is connected: the console bar's now playing zone should show the track name and source. visuals react to system audio regardless of which source you’ve picked for track info. if the visualizer is static while music plays, audio isn’t reaching ikandy. click 🎤 reconnect audio in setup (⚙) → audio tab , and check windows microphone permissions. i have 5.1 or 7.1 surround sound and the visuals barely move ikandy captures a stereo loopback stream. with 5.1/7.1 configured, windows mixes most music into rear/centre/sub channels, leaving the front l/r that ikandy captures very quiet. fix: set your default output to stereo (2 channel) : right-click speaker icon → sounds → playback tab. right-click your active output → configure speakers → choose stereo . right-click again → properties → advanced → pick a 2-channel format from default format . apply, then in ikandy hit 🎤 reconnect audio in setup (⚙) → audio tab . lyrics aren't showing up lyrics load from your own files, matched by the artist and title of the playing track: a synced .lrc next to the track, or one in your linked lyrics folder. if no local file matches, ikandy shows nothing instead of guessing. use add lyrics and tap to time to create one; see the lyrics guide . also check: if your files have incorrect artist/title tags, the match can land on the wrong song. performance is choppy or stuttering ikandy is gpu-bound. if your gpu is busy with another task, frame rate will suffer. try: step visual quality down (setup, picture tab); pick a simpler scene (spectrum or aurora instead of starfield); or turn off extras that each add a full-frame pass, such as god rays or a look (set it to original in the motion window). on laptops, make sure ikandy is using the discrete gpu: in windows, settings → system → display → graphics . if the comfort chip shows in the bottom left corner, comfort mode is on, and it lowers the frame rate. click the chip to turn it off. parts of the picture dim in blocks, or a moving light leaves a dark trail that is comfort mode holding a flash back. it shows most on bright scenes. comfort mode is on only when you turned it on, at the first start or in setup, and the comfort chip in the bottom left corner shows it is on. to turn it off, click the chip, or choose off in setup, comfort , comfort and flashing. a scene or preset flashes too much for me turn on comfort mode in setup, comfort , comfort and flashing. it holds back fast flashing, keeps intensity at 6 or lower and turns every motion move off. milkdrop and warpfield presets play as their authors made them, and some flash or move fast; comfort mode holds them back too. intensity all the way down stops every reaction to the music. the app won't launch / crashes on startup ikandy opens about two seconds after you accept the license. the first time this version starts on your pc, now playing, lyrics, logos and pets can take up to a minute and a half to appear; after that they are there at once. try a clean reinstall: uninstall via windows settings → apps, delete %appdata%\ikandy , then reinstall the latest build. if it still crashes, email support@ikandy.app with your windows version, gpu, and any error message shown. if ikandy opens, press ctrl + shift + d to save a diagnostic file for support and attach it. ikandy 1.7 was tested on nvidia graphics cards only; amd and intel graphics cards were not tested. where are my settings stored? ikandy stores all user data in the electron userdata folder: %appdata%\ikandy (paste into the explorer address bar). files stored there include source preferences, preset reactivity scores, favorites, hidden presets, and thumbnail cache. uninstall note: the standard nsis uninstaller on windows does not delete %appdata%\ikandy . your settings, favorites, and cached thumbnails survive an uninstall and are picked up automatically when you reinstall. to fully reset ikandy, delete that folder manually after uninstalling. get help stuck? reach out. discord for chat and quick answers, email for bugs, coffee if it made your day. 💬 discord 🐛 report a bug ☕ support ←
